title: Reviewer upgrades from pr-sweep: citation check, checklist, per-repo focus
body:
Closes #42

## Why
The owner's `pr-sweep` skill has review-quality ideas that fit aoa's existing reviewer without new tools.

## What
- `publish_pr_review` checks findings against the PR diff: a file or line the diff does not show is removed from a finding, which is always kept (the original citation moves into its text). The verdict never changes, and the posted review and the Slack card say how many locations were removed. Skipped (review used as is) if the head moved, the diff is unavailable or too large, or the PR read fails.
- Reviewer task gets a checklist (silent test skips, vacuous asserts, over-mocking, tests-only PRs that change prod code, silent reverts) and "cite only what is in the diff".
- Per-repo review notes from a local file, `<data_dir>/review-focus/<owner>__<repo>.md`; never read from the PR or repo.
- Two soft evals.

## Testing
- 226 tests pass, including replay tests (no workflow command changed; `build_task` and the activity internals only).
- Evals, 3 runs each: the three existing review cases and the two new ones pass 3/3. The two new cases also pass 3/3 with the checklist removed, so they are regression guards.

## Rollout
Restart worker and server. No config required.
